segments.t: 格雷厄姆拉动了走廊地板上落满灰尘的铁把手。伴随着一声干燥木头的摩擦声，门向上翻开。楼梯里一片漆黑。准备好了吗？场景三，开始。
Look at these tall glass windows facing the courtyard tree!
The shutters are closed outside, that is why nobody noticed from the stones!
Now I remember! My uncle called this the winter tea room when I was ten!
Why did someone lock a beautiful bright room behind a bookcase?
The glass roof leaked one rainy spring, and nobody had money to fix it.
Look at the dry stone floor, Arthur. Not one drop of water anywhere!
Whoever fixed the courtyard roof years ago fixed this ceiling too!
Arthur, do you see how many small cafe tables can fit in here?
Wait, to keep our city heritage protection, we promised a public reading cafe!
And here is the exact room the city letter asked for!
Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and zero cold wind!
Wait, what is standing in the corner under that big white cloth?
现在我们把场景放慢，仔细分析所有的细节。
Look at these tall glass windows facing the courtyard tree!
'里面好黑。它通向我们地下室下面吗？'
The shutters are closed outside, that is why nobody noticed from the stones!
'我没看到蜘蛛。这更像是一个隐藏的、封闭的楼梯！'
Now I remember! My uncle called this the winter tea room when I was ten!
'那么这就是那间失踪的阳光房了！大自然肯定把窗户藏起来了。'
Why did someone lock a beautiful bright room behind a bookcase?
'在走下这七个木台阶之前，让我拿个手电筒。'
The glass roof leaked one rainy spring, and nobody had money to fix it.
'你一定是楼上房间的凯勒布。拿上这个备用手电筒。'
Look at the dry stone floor, Arthur. Not one drop of water anywhere!
'谢谢您。我听到你们在搬那件重家具。'
Whoever fixed the courtyard roof years ago fixed this ceiling too!
'你是来帮忙看地下室的吗？'
Arthur, do you see how many small cafe tables can fit in here?
'看手电筒的光！这些根本不是地下室的墙。'
Wait, to keep our city heritage protection, we promised a public reading cafe!
'凯勒布是对的。它们是石砌的拱门，里面镶着巨大的深色玻璃！'
And here is the exact room the city letter asked for!
'就像一个老火车站！这棵老菩提树像厚厚的毯子一样覆盖着它们！'
Warm bread, hot tea, morning sun, and zero cold wind!
'像这样的一棵树值一大笔财富。如果它死了，你就会看到窗户。'
Wait, what is standing in the corner under that big white cloth?
'里面好黑。它通向我们地下室下面吗？'
接下来，让我们按自然语速再完整听一遍整场戏。
